title: Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.24479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset

translated_title: 每个查询自主路由：基于逐查询路由稀疏注意力加速视频扩散Transformer
translated_abstract: 对长token序列的自注意力计算主导了视频扩散Transformer的推理成本。基于聚类的稀疏注意力同时对查询和键进行聚类，并让同一簇中的所有查询共享同一个键簇选择。我们证明了这种共享限制了准确性：在键簇和密度固定的情况下，随着查询簇的精细化，注意力变得更加准确，而当每个查询独立进行选择时最为准确，这完全不需要查询聚类。因此，我们提出了逐查询路由稀疏注意力（PQRS），这是一种无需训练的方法，仅对键进行聚类，让每个查询选择自己的键簇，并用质心来补偿未被选择的键簇。逐查询的选择使得没有任何查询块会共享键列表，因此PQRS遍历键簇而非查询，将具有相同选择的查询分桶为稠密任务，并在固定的softmax偏移量下一次合并它们的局部结果。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的逐查询路由稀疏注意力方法PQRS，让每个查询独立选择自己的键簇并用质心补偿未选中的键簇，从而在提升注意力精度的同时加速视频扩散Transformer的推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes PQRS, a training-free per-query routed sparse attention method where each query independently selects its own key clusters with centroid compensation for unselected ones, accelerating video diffusion transformer inference while improving attention accuracy.
